purpose: Bounded method evidence, not recipe findings or publication authorization.

sources.access: Relevant full page text read through web open.
sources.section: Plain Grains; Grain Pilaf; Important: Time Varies
sources.claim: Absorption cooking simmers grain with liquid; pilaf first coats grain in oil. Grain age, variety and pan affect timing. If still firm after nominal time, additional water and cooking may be needed.
sources.application: Evaluate specified product, tenderness and liquid availability, using package guidance when available.
sources.exclusion: Whole-grain overview is not one ratio for white rice, quinoa, instant grain or cornmeal; drainage recovery does not automatically suit creamy porridge.

sources.access: Relevant full page text read through web open.
sources.claim: Whole beef/pork roasts: 145°F (63°C), then 3-minute rest. Ground meat: 160°F (71°C). Leftovers: 165°F (74°C).
sources.application: Match food category and measure internal temperature.
sources.exclusion: Minimum safety temperatures do not establish tenderness, cooking duration, cooling/storage limits or every preparation-specific hazard.

editorialChecksNotSourceClaims: Inventory every source of cooking liquid, grain preparation, lid state and required rest. Specify dry versus cooked amount.
Test desired grain/porridge texture; retain unknown absorption and finished yield as unknown. A timer alone cannot establish tenderness.
unknowns: Cooling and storage guidance unavailable in this packet; a USDA leftovers page returned 403. Do not derive storage duration from cooking-temperature guidance.
limits: No recipe-specific blind-reference findings used. No kitchen test. Quantities, yields, safety changes and identity changes require exception review.
